y-m-52-01.title: If we swap order, result remain same?

If connect dem as 'f then g', result na g(f(x)); if 'g then f', result na f(g(x)). Minseo say, “For any two machines, result same even if you swap order. Our machines too work when I put 0. f then g: f(0)=1, g(1)=1. g then f: g(0)=0, f(0)=1.”

y-m-52-06.title: How many times curve and line meet?
y-m-52-06.topic: Number of intersections of graph of irrational function and a line
y-m-52-06.goal: Learn say discriminant of quadratic equation alone no fit decide number of intersections between irrational function and line; then find by yourself k range wey get exactly 2 intersections, considering domain and value range (x+k−1≥0).
y-m-52-06.material:
Graph of irrational function y = √(x+2) + 1 na curve wey start from point (−2, 1) and rise towards upper-right, gradually flatting (x ≥ −2). We wan find number of intersections with line y = x + k.
Daeun solve am like this: "Set both expressions equal and get √(x+2) = x + k − 1; then square both sides to get x² + (2k−3)x + (k−1)² − 2 = 0. Discriminant of this quadratic equation na 13 − 4k, so if k < 13/4, two different real roots dey, meaning two intersections."

y-m-52-06.thinking.1: Check whether the solutions you find follow the original expression
y-m-52-06.thinking.2: Make several values wey follow a condition

y-m-52-06.s.s1.prompt: When k=0, Daeun quadratic equation na x² − 3x − 1 = 0, and its two roots about 3.30 and −0.30. Put both roots inside original expression √(x+2)=x−1. What be your judgment about Daeun conclusion (two intersections)?

y-m-52-06.s.s1.r.a: This judgment put the roots into original expression and check even signs on both sides.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.o.b: E correct. Quadratic equation get two roots and dem dey inside domain x ≥ −2, so two intersections dey.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.r.b: You only check say roots dey inside domain. Check again whether signs on both sides of original expression match too.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.o.c: E no correct. Quadratic equation no get roots, so 0 intersections dey.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.r.c: Equation x²−3x−1=0 really get real roots. The question na whether those roots follow original expression.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.o.d: E no correct, but domain na the cause. x=−0.30 okay because x≥−2, so one of the roots get calculation mistake.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.r.d: x=−0.30 dey inside domain. Find another reason and compare the answers when you put them in original expression.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.explain: √(x+2) na 0 or more, so x−1 too gats be 0 or more. If x=−0.30, then x−1=−1.30<0, so e no follow √(x+2)=x−1 (squaring both sides create false root). When k=0, the only real intersection na around x≈3.30.
y-m-52-06.s.s2.prompt: Find 3 different k values wey make line y = x + k and curve y = √(x+2) + 1 meet at two different points. (You fit enter decimals.)

y-m-52-06.s.s2.fail.c1: For this k, number of intersections no be 2. Think whether line dey above or below curve starting point (-2, 1), and when e touch curve.
y-m-52-06.s.s2.explain: Let t=√(x+2) (t≥0). The points where y=x+k meet curve y=√(x+2)+1 match the roots t≥0 of k=−t²+t+3, one point for each root. For t≥0, −t²+t+3 na 3 at t=0 and maximum na 13/4 at t=1/2. So if 3≤k<13/4, 2 intersections dey; if k=13/4, dem touch and 1 dey; if k<3, 1 dey; if k>13/4, 0 dey. For example, if k=3, dem meet at (−2,1) and (−1,2).
